document.title: Home
document.description: Starter landing page. Edit or replace it in the admin under Content.

blocks.heading: Launch your AI product faster
blocks.text: Accounts, billing, credits, content and an admin console are already wired together. Replace this text with your own pitch.

items.title: Accounts and sign-in
items.text: Email sign-up with verification, password reset, OAuth providers and API keys.

items.title: Billing and credits
items.text: Subscriptions, one-time purchases and credit packs with an auditable credit ledger.

items.title: Content you can edit
items.text: Landing pages, blog, docs, changelog and legal pages managed from the admin console.

items.title: Operations built in
items.text: Roles and permissions, audit logs, runtime settings and background jobs.

blocks.heading: Simple, transparent pricing
blocks.text: Plans and credit packs come from the admin console. They become purchasable once a payment provider is enabled.

items.question: Can I change this page?
items.answer: Yes. Edit the published home page in the admin under Content, or publish a page with the slug "home" to replace this starter version.

items.question: Do I need payment credentials to try it?
items.answer: No. The site runs without providers; plans become purchasable once a payment provider is enabled in the admin.

blocks.heading: Ready to start?
blocks.text: Create an account and explore the console.
